text: The Nominating Panel - Toronto Local Appeal Body will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body. The Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend four candidates to City Council for appointment.

The Nominating Panel - Toronto Local Appeal Body: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body: LAB 3-112 LAB 3-111 LAB 3-117 LAB 3-76 LAB 3-86 LAB 3-101 LAB 3-114 LAB 3-115 LAB 3-74 LAB 3-119 LAB 3-80 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (June 9, 2022) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body.
